_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage
filler_traps.description: The percentage of 'Jam Jar' filler items in the pool that will be replaced with traps.

description: Which of Strawberry Jam's 5 lobbies you intend to run.
Whether or not to include items and locations exclusively related to puzzle levels, such as Dropzle and A Gift From the Stars.
Whether or not to shuffle the various benches across each lobby into the item pool.
If enabled, these are marked as useful items, and as such, will not affect logic.
How to handle access to different levels.
Locked: Each level must be unlocked individually, and can be completed in full once received as an item.
Open World: Grants access to all levels from the get-go, instead putting different mechanics into the item pool.
NOTE: Open World logic assumes knowledge of all tech taught in vanilla Celeste, as well as all Strawberry Jam gyms going up to your chosen lobby.
How logical requirements for Seeing is Believing should be handled if Level Locking is set to Open World.
Developer Intended: Any mechanics used in the level will be required as soon as they are introduced.
Silly: Assumes you will be treating this level like any other ordinary level, ignoring the blindfold aspect entirely.
Whether or not to include checks for collecting the Silver Berries, the Heartside's Golden Strawberry, and the lobby's Rainbow Berry.
Whether or not jumping on Intro Cars gives checks.
Whether or not looking into each pair of Binoculars gives checks.
What you are required to do to complete your game.
Heartside: Collect enough Mini Hearts to unlock and beat the Heartside level for your chosen lobby.
Strawberries: Collect a set number of Strawberries from the item pool.
What percentage of Mini Hearts from your chosen lobby you must receive to unlock its corresponding Heartside level.
This option will affect your goal requirements if your goal is set to Heartside.
How many Strawberries will be placed into the item pool.
What percentage of Strawberries in the item pool you must receive to goal, if your goal is set to Strawberries.
